pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why does Al-Falaq teach us to seek refuge from envy? (1 mark)
   A. Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   B. Envy is a game
   C. Envy makes people rich
   D. Envy brings prayer

2. Which surah is number 110 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. An-Nasr

3. What does the verse "Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Read in the name of your Lord
   B. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   C. Allah is the Most Great
   D. Say: Allah is One

4. Which surah is number 112 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Falaq

5. What does "Al-Amin" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The tall
   B. The rich
   C. The trustworthy
   D. The strong

6. Which is an example of copying the Prophet's kindness? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding a friend's book
   B. Teasing a friend
   C. Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   D. Refusing to greet people

7. Who took care of the Prophet after his mother died and his grandfather passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Ali as a baby
   B. Waraqa
   C. His uncle Abu Talib
   D. Abu Bakr

8. Why is it good to have fresh breath when praying and meeting people? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. It makes prayer shorter
   C. It is respectful to Allah and to others
   D. It makes us tall

9. How often should a toothbrush be replaced? (1 mark)
   A. Every day
   B. Never
   C. Every ten years
   D. About every three months or when bristles bend

10. What does physical fitness mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sleeping a lot
   B. Having many clothes
   C. Eating sweets
   D. A healthy, active and strong body

11. Which angels do Muslims believe sit beside every person? (1 mark)
   A. Ten guards
   B. Two recording angels
   C. Four rain angels
   D. None

12. Which angel is in charge of rain and provision? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Raqib
   C. Israfil
   D. Jibril

13. Why did Allah create angels? (1 mark)
   A. To worship Him and carry out His orders
   B. To rule over people
   C. To be worshipped
   D. To play

14. Yahya was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim
   B. Musa
   C. Dawud
   D. Zakariyya

15. The Qur'an mentions prophets in Surah 6 verses 84-86 and other places. Why should we learn their stories? (1 mark)
   A. To learn lessons and virtues
   B. To avoid work
   C. To become kings
   D. To boast

16. What is honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding things
   B. Telling lies
   C. Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   D. Boasting

17. Which water cannot be used to purify? (1 mark)
   A. Clean rain water
   B. Tap water
   C. Well water
   D. Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa

18. Which of these is recommended before going to sleep? (1 mark)
   A. Eat a big meal
   B. Shout
   C. Make wudhu
   D. Skip prayer

19. What do we say at the start of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Bismillah
   C. Nothing
   D. Amin

20. What is a nullifier of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. Something that breaks wudhu
   C. A step of wudhu
   D. A drink

21. What is wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Giving zakat
   B. A journey
   C. Reciting the Qur'an
   D. Washing certain body parts with water before prayer

22. What is the tashahhud? (1 mark)
   A. A bowing
   B. The niyyah
   C. The call to prayer
   D. The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith

23. What is niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Standing
   B. Bowing
   C. Intention
   D. Greeting

24. What do we say in ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah
   B. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   C. Bismillah
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la

25. Which animal is often used to pull ploughs on farms? (1 mark)
   A. Zebra
   B. Lion
   C. Giraffe
   D. Ox

26. Which action shows cruelty? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing stones at a bird
   B. Watering a cow
   C. Feeding a goat
   D. Giving shade

27. Which statement about dress is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Rules are only for adults
   B. Nobody has rules
   C. Only girls have rules
   D. Boys also have rules of modesty

28. Which is a Kenyan Muslim garment for men? (1 mark)
   A. Kanzu
   B. Hijab
   C. Sari
   D. Buibui

29. What is a buibui? (1 mark)
   A. A drink
   B. A black cover worn by women along the coast
   C. A cap
   D. A prayer

30. Which is a positive use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing rumours
   B. Watching harmful content
   C. Bullying online
   D. Learning a surah with a recording

31. What does Qur'an 62:10 tell us after prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Stay at home
   B. Beg
   C. Stop working
   D. Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty

32. What do we say when leaving the house? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah only
   B. Amin only
   C. Bismillahi walajna
   D. Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

33. Which benefit comes when parents fulfil their duties? (1 mark)
   A. Children grow safe and well-behaved
   B. Children become unhappy
   C. Families become weak
   D. No benefit

34. Which of these shows love from parents? (1 mark)
   A. Comparing children
   B. Listening and praising good behaviour
   C. Shouting all day
   D. Ignoring

35. What did the Prophet say about being fair among children? (1 mark)
   A. Favour the eldest
   B. Favour boys
   C. Favour the youngest
   D. Fear Allah and be fair

36. Who is a "shangazi"? (1 mark)
   A. Father's sister
   B. Grandfather
   C. Mother's brother
   D. Cousin

37. What does "R.A." stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Rest at once
   B. Read Allah
   C. May Allah be pleased with him or her
   D. Peace be upon him

38. Why is it hard to be among the first to believe? (1 mark)
   A. Everyone accepted
   B. No one cared
   C. It was easy
   D. Few people believed and many opposed

39. What did the angel of the mountains offer? (1 mark)
   A. To bring rain
   B. To crush the people between two mountains
   C. To carry him
   D. To bring food

40. Which virtue is shown by refusing revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Pride
   C. Envy
   D. Mercy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State two ways to know the times of prayer. (2 marks)

42. State three virtues the Prophet showed in Taif. (3 marks)

43. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

44. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)

45. Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance. (4 marks)

46. Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud. (3 marks)

47. Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home. (5 marks)

48. State the hadith of eating that is in your syllabus. (2 marks)

49. Give three negative uses of media. (3 marks)

50. Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim. (5 marks)

51. Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures. (4 marks)

52. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

53. Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an. (5 marks)

54. Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness. (3 marks)

55. State the dua for parents and its meaning. (2 marks)

56. Name three types of media and give one example of each. (3 marks)

57. State three benefits of saying the duas for leaving and entering the house. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   The fifth verse asks protection from the envier when he envies.

2. D — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is 110, Al-Masad 111 and Al-Kafirun 109.

3. B — You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   This is the fifth verse of Al-Fatiha.

4. B — Al-Ikhlas
   Al-Ikhlas is surah 112, Al-Falaq 113 and An-Naas 114.

5. C — The trustworthy
   The people of Makkah called Muhammad Al-Amin.

6. C — Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   Kindness means caring for others.

7. C — His uncle Abu Talib
   Abu Talib cared for him as a young boy.

8. C — It is respectful to Allah and to others
   A clean mouth shows respect.

9. D — About every three months or when bristles bend
   Worn bristles do not clean well.

10. D — A healthy, active and strong body
   Fitness means the body is healthy.

11. B — Two recording angels
   The Qur'an (50:17-18) mentions two.

12. A — Mikail
   Scholars explain this duty of Mikail.

13. A — To worship Him and carry out His orders
   Allah does not need them.

14. D — Zakariyya
   Yahya was the son of Zakariyya.

15. A — To learn lessons and virtues
   The stories teach us how to behave.

16. C — Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   Honest people are trusted.

17. D — Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa
   Its purity has been lost.

18. C — Make wudhu
   The Prophet told Al-Bara ibn Azib to do this.

19. B — Bismillah
   Bismillah begins good deeds.

20. B — Something that breaks wudhu
   It cancels the state of wudhu.

21. D — Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   Wudhu is ablution.

22. D — The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   It is recited in sitting.

23. C — Intention
   Niyyah is intention.

24. B — Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   Glory to my Lord, the Most Great.

25. D — Ox
   Oxen pull ploughs and carts.

26. A — Throwing stones at a bird
   Harming animals for fun is wrong.

27. D — Boys also have rules of modesty
   Both boys and girls dress modestly.

28. A — Kanzu
   Kanzu is a long robe.

29. B — A black cover worn by women along the coast
   A buibui is a cover.

30. D — Learning a surah with a recording
   Media can teach.

31. D — Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   Work and pray.

32. D — Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   This is the dua for leaving.

33. A — Children grow safe and well-behaved
   Strong families.

34. B — Listening and praising good behaviour
   Love is shown by care.

35. D — Fear Allah and be fair
   Fairness among children.

36. A — Father's sister
   Shangazi is father's sister.

37. C — May Allah be pleased with him or her
   Radiyallahu anhu.

38. D — Few people believed and many opposed
   The first believers faced hardship.

39. B — To crush the people between two mountains
   The Prophet refused.

40. D — Mercy
   Mercy is being kind to those who hurt us.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience, tolerance, perseverance, mercy, trust in Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable situation.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat what is directly in front of you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first two teachings and 1 mark for the third, or 1 mark each for correct halves.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watching harmful content, wasting time, spreading rumours, cyberbullying, unsafe contacts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

53. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with example.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, remembering Allah, blessings and peace, following the Sunnah, building good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
